work.title: The Mathieu Property over Fields of Characteristic Zero: Classification and Ground-Field Obstructions
work.abstract: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero and $X$ an affine geometrically homogeneous space of a group $G$ with split reductive identity component. The normalized Reynolds kernel on $K[X]$ is Mathieu–Zhao if and only if $[G^\circ,G^\circ]$ acts trivially. A single active split $\mathrm{SL}_2$ already gives a fixed marked counterexample for a connected reductive acting group. Both results allow $X(K)=\varnothing$. The proof transfers witnesses along principal orbits and specializes marked-moment recurrences over the ground field. We also classify connected reductive groups and compact adjoint semisimple torsors over real closed fields, and representative functions on compact Hausdorff homogeneous spaces. A long-root subgroup gives a further obstruction when a split central torus acts alongside an active compact factor of rank at least two.
